title: Izzat e mann
body:
Izzat e mann
Husain Husain...(4)
Ya zahra....
Ya Haider....
Shukriya fatema zahra
Shukriya Haider e qarraar
Aapne mujhko banaaya
Apne bete ka azadaar..(3)
Man misli.. mai azadar e Husain
<<MINI>>
Risaalat e mann nabawi
Wilaayat e mann alawi
Qismat e mann fatemi
Sakhawat e mann Hasani
Izzat e mann Husaini
Ghairat e mann Abbasi
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Ye jo sharaf mujhko mila aur kise rabb ne diya..(2)
Goondha gayaa mera khameer
usme mili khaak e shifaa..(2)
unse mujhe hai qalk kiyaa
Aab e baqaa, khaak e shifaa, zohd o sakhaa, Rab ki ataa
<<MINI>>
Risaalat e mann nabawi
Wilaayat e mann alawi
Qismat e mann fatemi
Sakhawat e mann Hasani
Izzat e mann Husaini
Ghairat e mann Abbasi
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Khalq mujhe rabb ne kiya
sirf moharram ke liye..(2)
Aankh hai rone ke liye
haath hai maatam ke liye..(2)
Daulat e mann kya iske siwaa
Farsh e azaa, farsh e wilaa, ashq e azaa, karbobala
<<MINI>>
Risaalat e mann nabawi
Wilaayat e mann alawi
Qismat e mann fatemi
Sakhawat e mann Hasani
Izzat e mann Husaini
Ghairat e mann Abbasi
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Seena hai kaaba e azaa
kaabe ka maulood Ali..(2)
Rabb ne jo meesaaq liya
dil me tha maujood Ali..(2) Aur Karam mujhpar ye huwaa
Dil Jo diya, usme rakha, ishq e khuda, sheh ki azaa
<<MINI>>
Risaalat e mann nabawi
Wilaayat e mann alawi
Qismat e mann fatemi
Sakhawat e mann Hasani
Izzat e mann Husaini
Ghairat e mann Abbasi
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Pehle waha wird kiya
<<MINI>>
sallu alaihi ya Husain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab ye wazeefa hai mera
<<MINI>>
sallu alaihi ya Husain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaam hai ye dunya me Mera
Nauha likha, nauha padha, nauha suna, kehta raha
<<MINI>>

Wilaayat e mann alawi
Qismat e mann fatemi
Sakhawat e mann Hasani
Izzat e mann Husaini
Ghairat e mann Abbasi
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Ishq e Ali mujhko mila aur ghum e karbobala..(2)
Jab bhi uthey mere qadam
pohcha sar e farsh e aaza..(2)
Qaidi koi yaado'n me rahaa
Tauq e jafaa, me tha gala, kehta raha, Zain ul ebaa
<<MINI>>
Risaalat e mann nabawi
Wilaayat e mann alawi
Qismat e mann fatemi
Sakhawat e mann Hasani
Izzat e mann Husaini
Ghairat e mann Abbasi
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Asr ka hangaam e sitam
bhool na paaunga kabhi..(2)
Reyt ke teeley pe khadi
ek behan roti rahi..(2)
Dekhi nahi phir aisi jafaa
Khushk gala, kat-ta raha, khoon baha, kehta huwa
<<MINI>>

7) Baad e shah e Karbobala
ahle haram qaidi bane..(2)
shaam talak aise gaye
ek rasan baara gale..(2)
Binte Ali thi mehwe bukaa
Lehje me tha Sher e khuda, mehwe buka, khutba diya
<<MINI>>

8) Hoti hai maula ki ataa
likhta hai Mazhar ka qalam..(2)
Mujhpey bhi Irfan e aza
hai ye shah e dee'n ka Karam..(2)
Naad e Ali jo mujhko milaa
Shukr e khuda, khoon mera, meri tarha, kehne lagaa
<<MINI>>

Husain... Husain... Ya zehra....
